characters.name: Mov
characters.age: adult (established Order member; Gladias's peer or slightly senior)
characters.voice_notes: Gladias's close friend and mentor in the Order of Steering (a Keeper, selected as a Herald in ch. 8). Wry, sarcastic, sharp, security-paranoid but warm underneath; talks fast and knowledgeably. Partly heard by call/earpiece.

characters.name: Gladias
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Veridia chapters. Thoughtful, calm, gentle, philosophical, with an occasional mischievous streak; a little awkward under pressure. Acolyte of the Order of Steering (accepted as a Keeper in ch. 8). Husband of Seila, father of Zven and Lily. Many of his lines are subvocalised whispers through a neck band.

characters.name: Pelae
characters.voice_notes: Citizens' assembly participant who sits next to Gladias. Curious, bright, forthright; plans to study chemistry. Some lines are whispered via neck band.

characters.name: Alagael
characters.age: adult (a Herald for seven years, i.e. a retired Order member; likely middle-aged or older)
characters.voice_notes: Herald who facilitates the citizens' assembly; welcoming, clear public-speaking voice with gentle humour.

characters.name: middle-aged woman at assembly
characters.voice_notes: Soft-spoken participant at Gladias's table who speaks first; fond, contented description of her favourite square.

characters.name: second woman at assembly
characters.voice_notes: Another participant at the table, a mother; speaks by whisper through a neck band but sounds clear and natural; mildly critical, practical.

characters.name: Febric
characters.age: teen (older teenager, not quite an adult)
characters.voice_notes: Bright, enthusiastic, affectionate programming geek; son of Vil and Daia (the co-family); calls Gladias 'Uncle Glad'.

characters.name: Order member
characters.voice_notes: One of ten robed, anonymous Order of Steering members presiding over the track-choice ceremony; solemn, formal, ritual tone, slightly thrown by Gladias's joke.

notes: No letter is shared within the chapter. The first scene is a call (Mov heard through Gladias's earpiece; Gladias subvocalising). 6:57 Gladias speaks through his neck band; 6:75 and the second woman's 6:106 are heard via neck band/earpiece. 6:84 (G) follows a question Mov asked Pelae, but the letter marks it as Gladias. All five O runs (6:160, 6:162, 6:165, 6:167, 6:170) are treated as the same single Order member; the text introduces one speaker and never signals a change of speaker.
